Modeling Approach: Native quartic spin Hamiltonian of LABS (PUBO), no quadratization and no penalty terms. Exact quantum-classical branch and bound (QCBB) with fixed-angle QAOA as the sampler at every node
Workflow: Best-first branch and bound in one process: at every node the symmetry rule, propagation and the classical lower bound, then sampling of the node Hamiltonian with fixed-angle QAOA (p=12, 1,000 shots, exact noiseless statevector emulation on the CPU, at most 26 qubits; only the root at n = 27-30 is larger and is split into its symmetry classes without being sampled); the samples give incumbents and the branching spin; the run stops when no open node can improve the incumbent
Hardware Specifications: Apple MacBook Pro, M4 Pro (8 performance + 4 efficiency cores), 24 GB RAM
Remarks: 5 independent runs with the seeds 1, 2, 3, 4, 5; every run proved optimality, with certified lower bound = energy = 39. A run: one process, fixed-angle QAOA at p=12 on the exact noiseless emulation as the sampler at every node, 1,000 shots per node, no time limit. Best Objective Value: the lowest energy over the runs. Optimality Bound: the largest certified lower bound over the runs; its certificate is labs022_certificate.json. Total Runtime: wall-clock time of the whole solve, from its start to the proof. Time to Solution: wall-clock time from the start until the run first held a sequence of its final energy. CPU Runtime: measured CPU time of all threads of the process. All three are means over the runs. No GPU and no QPU were used; the QAOA circuits are emulated on the CPU. Software: macOS 27.0.1, Python 3.13.7, NumPy 2.5.4, Numba 0.68.1.
